notes: Assumptions that move the number: 6 wholewheat tortillas × 60 g (25 cm) at the USDA whole-wheat tortilla value (1116 kcal, 46 % of the total; SA wraps run 280–310 kcal / 100 g); kidney beans 240 g drained per tin; 80 g cheddar; quesadillas dry-toasted, the only oil is 1 tsp. Lettuce taken as ½ an iceberg (270 g). Cross-check: published bean quesadillas list ~450–550 kcal for 1–1½ tortillas; this is 1½ tortillas plus salsa and salad, so 610 is within ~20 %. Published figures are recalled, not re-fetched (the shared web budget was spent).
